description: This source file defines the class 'EditSmartViewModalController', which manages the state and behavior of a modal dialog for editing 'SmartView' objects within a web application. It includes observable properties, actions for updating state, methods for saving, deleting, and validating data, and interacts with application mutators and confirmation dialogs.

classes.name: EditSmartViewModalController
classes.description: Controller class for managing the editing of SmartView objects in a modal dialog, including state management, validation, and save/delete operations.

methods.name: setIsPredicateJsonValid
methods.description: Sets the boolean indicating if predicate JSON is valid.

methods.name: setView
methods.description: Initializes view data and updates observable properties based on the provided SmartView object.

methods.name: closeDialog
methods.description: Resets view-related data and clears the dialog state.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates, saves changes to the SmartView via the application's mutator, and closes the dialog.

methods.name: deleteView
methods.description: Prompts for deletion confirmation and deletes the current SmartView if confirmed.

methods.name: validateAndPrettifyCustomPredicate
methods.description: Validates the predicate JSON string and formats it with indentation.
